b10a282390:
Palau.
A civilian mining asteroid belonging to Side 6.
0f818dcbe5:
Intelligence has concluded that
the RX-0 was brought here.
3d3ad6ac47:
I have no objection to the orders.
However, we regard this as a hostage rescue operation.
82c9426ea3:
He can't get out of Palau.
Still, I didn't think he had that kind of nerve...
5b0bcc26cd:
When the Unicorn Gundam activates the NT-D,
the data on the Box is disclosed.
That data is what we want...
35867e831c:
Aboard the Nahel Argama, which had lost the Unicorn
Gundam and Banagher Links to Neo Zeon,
a plan to retake the Gundam was being discussed.
324c6a9838:
Alberto Vist demanded that the Nahel Argama alone
assault Neo Zeon's base at Palau and retake
the Unicorn Gundam amid the confusion.
78a806be57:
The crew objected to the reckless plan as one. But
Daguza Mackle, leader of the special forces unit
ECOAS, silently nodded.
67f13c6ba1:
Unlike Alberto, who only meant to retake the
Unicorn Gundam, Daguza declared they would
rescue its pilot, Banagher, as well.
e137d281ab:
Held captive in a house in Palau, Banagher tried
to escape with the help of a Federation spy.
But Neo Zeon soon found out.
5dd7d32a9a:
The Unicorn Gundam, key to Laplace's Box. While
ordering its capture, Full Frontal joined the pursuit
with a different design of his own.
7bfd2a596c:
The Gundam's going to be taken!
Do something, Commander Daguza!
2fece4519d:
It's fine, I have a recovery team hidden.
Captain, give us cover with the hyper mega particle cannon!
924a81695b: Is that what that boy did...?
3f9c997657:
Not exactly. It's the NT-D.
When it identifies an enemy as a Newtype,
the machine's limiters are released.
16971e29e7:
A hunting machine that combines a supernatural
interface through its psycoframe with the power
to control the enemy's psycommu weapons...
76904890ec: So Marida is just the sacrificial lamb, then.
fcfdb27741:
The place the Unicorn pointed to is the ruins of
the Prime Minister's residence in orbit, then.
43dcbbce4c:
Surely it won't be a miss this time.
For breaking Laplace's seal, it's almost too perfect a place.
155426bad5:
Struck by the Sinanju, the Unicorn Gundam stops
moving. Seeing this, Alberto's scream echoed
across the bridge of the Nahel Argama.
e41aa9aa5f:
Catching Neo Zeon off guard, the Nahel Argama charged
in and carried off the Unicorn Gundam.
But Frontal did not order a pursuit.
2694c06edd:
The NT-D reveals the way to Laplace's Box.
To activate it, the presence of an enemy
Newtype was essential.
0a301fcb8b:
The NT-D activated in front of the Enhanced Human
Marida. And the Unicorn Gundam revealed the next
clue to the Box. All as Frontal intended...
